name: Passage study
description: A careful study of one passage, moving from the text itself to teaching it.

sections.title: Text
sections.guidance: The passage being studied, and any translation notes.

sections.title: Context
sections.guidance: Where the passage sits: the book, the surrounding argument, the historical setting.

sections.title: Observations
sections.guidance: What does the text say? Repeated words, connectors, contrasts, commands, questions.

sections.title: Structure
sections.guidance: How the passage is built: its movements, main clauses and turning points.

sections.title: Exegesis
sections.guidance: What did the text mean for its first readers? Key words, grammar, difficult phrases.

sections.title: Theology
sections.guidance: What the passage teaches about God, Christ, salvation and the life of faith.

sections.title: Application
sections.guidance: How the truth of the passage bears on belief, worship and life today.

sections.title: Audience
sections.guidance: Who will hear this teaching, what they need, and what may hinder them.

sections.title: Teaching
sections.guidance: Main idea, outline, illustrations and how to communicate it with love.
